summary: Security fix, update soon with piiShield: up to 0.24.2 an e-mail, IBAN or phone number right after a line break, tab or other JSON-escaped character in a tool result (also result handles, approvals, view context) could reach the model in plain text.
howTo: Nothing to change in code: update. Results without escaped characters are shielded exactly as before (one detector call, same text). For a result with escapes the detector is called a second time with the strings decoded (real line breaks, tabs, control characters); a remote detector costs two calls there, the audit entry lists the extra findings. Never less is replaced than before. Limits: a built-in pattern may take a following tab column into the pseudonym; object keys and numbers are not pseudonymized.
